Closing verification (sanctioned non-force path), main @9bdb22f5887. Ticked all 4 ACs after independently re-verifying:

- AC1: 'grep -rn three-pass src/rebar docs/plan-review-gate.md' returns SIX hits, and every one is out of scope by this ticket's own Scope section: three reviewer prompt .md files (plan_review_finder.md:4,11; plan_review_verifier.md:4,12; plan_review_verifier_agentic.md:13) and the preserved epic-9da1 lineage line at docs/plan-review-gate.md:158. Every gate-level surface now reads four-pass: src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py:1, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:10, src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py:484 and :498, src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_verdict.schema.json:5. The MCP review_plan docstring moved to src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:195 and reads four-pass there; attest.py's module docstring was rewritten and no longer states a pass count, so no stale label remains.
- AC2: preserved verbatim at docs/plan-review-gate.md:158 — 'the find -> verify -> decide decision core is the shared three-pass framework'.
- AC3: the reviewer prompt .md front-matter still carries its original 'three-pass gate' description text — i.e. untouched, so the prompt-index drift gate was never engaged.
- AC4: 'make lint' is clean. NOTE for anyone re-running this: it must be run with the PINNED ruff. This checkout's .venv carries ruff 0.15.19 while pyproject pins ruff==0.16.1, and the stale one reports 101 spurious BLE001/T201 errors. With the pinned build — 'uvx ruff@0.16.1 check src tests' -> All checks passed; 'uvx ruff@0.16.1 format --check src tests' -> 1721 files already formatted. 'make typecheck' -> Success: no issues found in 438 source files. The change is also on origin/main, which only accepts changes carrying Verified +1 (CI green) and LLM-Review +1.
